### 1. API Documentation & Inventory
We ran `deno doc` against the `@netscript/fresh-ui` package exports (details recorded in the worklog [worklog.md](file:///home/codex/repos/ns005-tutorials/.llm/runs/docs-tutorials-page-builder/worklog.md)). 

The **`@netscript/fresh-ui`** runtime API exports:
- **`.`**: [DataGrid](file:///home/codex/repos/ns005-tutorials/packages/fresh-ui/src/presentation/data-grid.tsx#L192) component, [Icon](file:///home/codex/repos/ns005-tutorials/packages/fresh-ui/src/presentation/primitives.tsx#L204) component, redirect-flash toast helpers (`getToast`, `stripToastFromUrl`, `withToast`), and style classname merger (`cn`).
- **`./ai/render-ui`**: Bounded generative-UI whitelisted renderer ([RenderUiSurface](file:///home/codex/repos/ns005-tutorials/packages/fresh-ui/src/ai/render-ui.tsx#L146) and `renderUiPayload`).
- **`./desktop`**: Native tray, notification, window chrome, and menu capabilities (`createDesktopChrome`).
- **`./interactive`**: Stateless accessibility primitives namespace wrappers (`ActionMenu`, `Accordion`, `Combobox`, `Dialog`, `Drawer`, `Popover`, `Sheet`, `Tabs`, `Tooltip`).
- **`./primitives`**: Base visual nodes (`Icon`, `Show`, `SrOnly`, `VisuallyHidden`).
- **`./registry`**: Copy-based manifest directory descriptor (`freshUiRegistryManifest`).

---

### 2. Upgraded Tutorial Coverage
We updated [04-definePage-QueryIsland.md](file:///home/codex/repos/ns005-tutorials/docs/site/tutorials/live-dashboard/04-definePage-QueryIsland.md) to serve as the master tutorial demonstrating **all** page-builder features with real type-safe code examples:
- **Contract-first routing**: Bound route contract parameter injection via `.withRoute()`.
- **Tracing**: Custom Span boundaries configured via `.withTelemetry()`.
- **Request-scoped resources**: De-duplicated auth session extraction (`.withResource('auth')`) and context-refined queries (`.withResource('ordersData')`).
- **Cache-first SDK reads**: Background SVR cache loading with `baseQueries.orders.list.getCachedEntry()`.
- **Server+client dehydration**: Handoff with `dehydrateQueryClient` (server) and `hydrateFromDehydrated` (client QueryIsland).
- **Server-bound form integration**: Input schema constraints with `.withForm()` and `RuntimeFormState.fieldErrors`.
- **Deferred partial rendering**: Streaming loading states asynchronously using `.withLayer()` mapped to a partial route and Preact `<Deferred>` component.
